evidence.notes: Aggregate aliases can be used in HAVING and ordered result rows expose alias and exprN fields.

The dateformats reference slice is covered by focused SOQL table tests; representative Apex fixture rows cover LAST_N_MONTHS, THIS_QUARTER, THIS_WEEK, LAST_N_WEEKS, N_MONTHS_AGO, LAST_N_QUARTERS, and date literals inside IN/NOT IN lists against the deterministic local VM clock.
Semicolon-delimited stored values support INCLUDES and EXCLUDES predicates.
Local QueryLocator exposes getQuery() and an eager snapshot iterator for supported SOQL.
One-argument Database.getQueryLocator returns a local QueryLocator snapshot for supported SOQL.

source.content: @isTest private class DataSoqlAggregateDateQueryLocatorTest { @isTest static void exercisesAggregateDateAndLocatorEdges() { insert new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100, RenewalDate__c = Date.today(), PriceClasses__c = 'Member;VIP'); insert new Account(Name = 'Gamma', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 300, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 4, 15), PriceClasses__c = 'Member'); insert new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 250, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 3, 15), PriceClasses__c = 'Public'); insert new Account(Name = 'Delta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 125, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 4, 25)); List<Object> grouped = [SELECT Rating, COUNT(Id) accountCount, SUM(AnnualRevenue) totalRevenue FROM Account GROUP BY Rating HAVING accountCount > 1 ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC]; System.assertEquals(2, grouped.size()); Object groupRow = grouped.get(0); System.assertEquals('Hot', groupRow.Rating); System.assertEquals(2, groupRow.expr0); System.assertEquals(400.0, groupRow.totalRevenue); List<Account> memberRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE PriceClasses__c INCLUDES ('Member')]; System.assertEquals(2, memberRows.size()); List<Account> notMemberRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE PriceClasses__c EXCLUDES ('Member')]; System.assertEquals(2, notMemberRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Beta', [SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE PriceClasses__c EXCLUDES ('Member')][0].Name); List<Account> priorMonthRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = LAST_N_MONTHS:1]; System.assertEquals(2, priorMonthRows.size()); List<Account> priorWeekRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = LAST_N_WEEKS:1]; System.assertEquals(1, priorWeekRows.size()); List<Account> monthAgoRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = N_MONTHS_AGO:1]; System.assertEquals(2, monthAgoRows.size()); List<Account> priorQuarterRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = LAST_N_QUARTERS:1]; System.assertEquals(1, priorQuarterRows.size()); List<Account> quarterRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = THIS_QUARTER]; System.assertEquals(3, quarterRows.size()); List<Account> weekRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = THIS_WEEK]; System.assertEquals(1, weekRows.size()); List<Account> weekOrPriorRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c IN (THIS_WEEK, LAST_N_WEEKS:1)]; System.assertEquals(2, weekOrPriorRows.size()); List<Account> outsideWeekOrPriorRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c NOT IN (THIS_WEEK, LAST_N_WEEKS:1)]; System.assertEquals(2, outsideWeekOrPriorRows.size()); Object locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', locator.getQuery()); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account first = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Acme', first.Name); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account second = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Beta', second.Name); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account third = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Delta', third.Name); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account fourth = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Gamma', fourth.Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); } }
